newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-NEW CAR REGISTRATIONS 312 IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-NEW CAR REGISTRATIONS 312 IN MARCH.

text.p: New car registrations in Latvia were 312 compared to February's 314, the Association of Authorised Car Dealers said on Thursday.
The total number of new cars registered was 858 as of March 31. The most popular cars were Ladas, the usual leader, with 146, Toyotas 80 and 76 Renaults, the association said in a statement.
The top three most popular cars changed compared to February, when it was led by Toyota with 60 cars sold, Renault 54 and 52 Ladas.
